items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s1: fixture repo (2 stamped scenarios), stub builder leaving a candidate (test.sh exit 0, start.sh serves 'sauna' on PORT). start-run R-1/C-1 responded; run-progress: status awaiting-verdicts, effect-results 1-9 = stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate, all outcome recorded; gate events = [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed].

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s2: R-1/C-1 failed with its cycle at the fence (self-check failing). start-run R-1/C-2 -> -32000 run-already-started; run-progress (all) lists exactly [(R-1, C-1)].

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s1: while R-1 awaited verdicts, start-run R-2/C-2 -> -32000 run-in-progress; run-progress R-2 = null; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s1: after R-1/C-1 passed (verdicts filed), start-run R-2/C-1 -> -32000 cycle-already-run; run-progress lists only R-1.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s3: start-run R-1 at commit deadbeef... (not in the fixture repo) -> -32000 not-a-commit; run-progress runs = []; stub builder log has no launch.

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: s3: LOYLY_CONTEXTS measurement entrypoint 'exit 0' -> -32000 contexts-not-responding, data.contexts = ['measurement']; run-progress runs = [].

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s1: relayed-handoffs of R-1: scenario-stamped pos 1 and 2 -> measurement, then source-cut-pinned pos 1 -> regeneration-cycle and -> measurement, then gate-attempt-passed pos 1 -> measurement exactly once; every outcome accepted.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s5: plan spec with 'Feature' and no scenario. stamp recorded (no events), pin recorded, checklist outcome refused, refusal 'empty-checklist' (measurement/derive-checklist); status halted, halt {effect checklist, reason refused-before-the-cycle}; only 3 effects, no self-check (stub self-check never ran), no fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: s5 (second commit): plan adds 'Scenario: three with no identity'. stamp recorded with 3 scenario-stamped events; run halted at stamp, reason refused-before-the-cycle, detail names plan identities [01-001 01-002] vs stamp [01-001 01-002 01-003]; 1 effect only (no pin, no checklist).

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s2: self-check prints 'golden checklist differs' last and exits 1. R-1 status failed; cycle.failure {stage fence, reason harness-self-check-failed, detail 'golden checklist differs'}; last effect (pos 4) self-check (harness-self-check-failed event); no fence, no regenerate.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: s7: self-check exit 0 printing 'SKIP bb-tools'. First self-check effect recorded with regeneration-cycle/harness-self-check-passed; detail 'done Skipped: bb-tools'; event skipped-checks ['bb-tools'].

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s8: FENCED_PATHS 'impl harness/cycles', commit without harness/cycles. fence effect refused 'fenced-path-matched-nothing' (regeneration-cycle/prove-clean-room); next effect fail-cycle recorded; R-1 failed, cycle.failure stage fence reason fence-refused; stub builder log empty.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: s9: fenced 'impl harness/cycles', commit holds both. Stub builder recorded its room: docs/plan/01-a/spec.feature, harness/config.sh, harness/probe.sh, empty ./impl; git rev-list --all --count = 1; rev-list --objects --all has no impl or harness/cycles path.

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it

items.evidence: s4: candidates red then green. Builder launched twice (launch1 = regenerate, launch2 = repair); launch2 start time after launch1 end time; effects show regenerate attempt 1 and repair attempt 2.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: s4: first candidate red. repair effect attempt 2 recorded (verification-repair, parent digest = attempt-1 candidate); repair builder room held docs/, harness/, empty impl/, previous-candidate/ and gate-evidence/ (suite.log identical to the run's evidence-1-1/suite.log); write probes: previous-candidate and gate-evidence dirs not writable (dr-xr-xr-x), files read-only; impl writable. (The candidate-regenerated event schema carries no mounted-evidence field; observed via the room.)

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, and no fourth builder is launched

items.evidence: s24: every candidate red, limit 3. Builder launched exactly 3 times; effects regenerate 1, gate 1, repair 2, gate 2, repair 3, gate 3; run failed, stage gate, gate-attempts-exhausted.
